claims.text: Job satisfaction is enjoyment derived from feeling that you have done a good job. Managers can support it through meaningful work, recognition, suitable responsibility, opportunities to develop and respectful relationships. Job enrichment adds challenge or responsibility, whereas merely adding similar repetitive tasks may increase workload without satisfaction. Genuine responsibility requires appropriate authority and support. Consultation can reveal practical improvements and make staff feel heard, but raising expectations without a credible response can undermine trust.

claims.text: Industrial action can take different forms.
